description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Alistar''' smashes the ground beneath him, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stunning]] and [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocking them up]] simultaneously for 1 second.
description.text: Active: Alistar smashes the ground beneath him, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and stunning and knocking them up simultaneously for 1 second.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
60 / 100 / 140 / 180 / 220 (+ 80% AP)

notes.raw: * ''Pulverize'' can be buffered during [[File:Alistar Headbutt.png|20xpx|border|link=Alistar#Headbutt|An icon for Alistar's ability Headbutt]] [[Alistar#Headbutt|Headbutt]] to cast with reduced cast time when the dash ends. * [[File:Unstoppable icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Displacement immune]] [[:Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|Displacement immunity]] will also resist the application of the [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]]. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
notes.text:
Pulverize can be buffered during Headbutt to cast with reduced cast time when the dash ends.
Displacement immunity will also resist the application of the stun.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
